configuration_map: No geometric configuration to track. All entities (m, r, s, a, b, u) are straight lines related purely by commensurability and proportion. The proof manipulates area equalities (R(r,s) = Q(m) = R(a,b)), proportion chains (a:r = s:b, Q(a):Q(r) = Q(s):Q(b)), and commensurability transfers (10.11, 10.12). No points are placed in a spatial figure, no angles are decomposed, and no inside/outside/between relationships are asserted.
skip_reason: The proof is purely algebraic/proportional, dealing entirely with commensurability relations, area equalities, and proportion chains among straight lines treated as magnitudes. No geometric configuration claims (point positions, ray orderings, angle decompositions, interior/exterior arguments) are made. This is characteristic of the algebraic portions of Book 10.
